tasks.name: מיון לפי מרחק מהממוצע
tasks.note: Elements ordered by their distance from the exact mean, input order on ties.

tasks.name: סכומי שכנים חוצים 24
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if((l[i-1]+l[i]<24)!==(l[i]+l[i+1]<24)) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Interior positions where exactly one of the two neighbouring pair sums is below 24.

tasks.name: שלישיות לא מונוטוניות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; const n=l.length; for(let i=0;i<n;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++) for(let k=j+1;k<n;k++) if((l[i]<l[j])!==(l[j]<l[k])) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Number of index triples i<j<k whose values are not monotone (capped at 15).

tasks.name: שכן אחד מאותה רביעייה
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; const q=x=>x>>2; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if((q(l[i-1])===q(l[i]))!==(q(l[i])===q(l[i+1]))) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Interior positions where exactly one neighbour is in the same block of four values.

tasks.name: שלישיות הר
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; const n=l.length; for(let i=0;i<n;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++) for(let k=j+1;k<n;k++) if(l[i]<l[j]&&l[j]>l[k]) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Number of index triples i<j<k with a peak in the middle (capped at 15).

tasks.name: סוף זוג באותה זוגיות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i-1]%2===l[i]%2&&l[i]%2!==l[i+1]%2) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Interior positions where a same-parity step is followed by a parity change.
